# RK RATE Android test app

For R K SYNTHETICS.

- [Download APK](https://github.com/somenathpanda29-sketch/spview/raw/refs/heads/main/dist/RK-RATE-test.apk)
- [Download ZIP containing APK](https://github.com/somenathpanda29-sketch/spview/raw/refs/heads/main/dist/RK-RATE-Android.zip)

Install on Android 8 or later. If using the ZIP, extract it first. This is a development-signed test build; it has not been tested on a physical Android phone.

The app requires your RK RATE website to be deployed over HTTPS. Enter that website address on first launch. The APK does not include the website server, BUSY database, user accounts or business data. Live BUSY syncing also requires the Windows shop connector.
